text_block_list.text:
One day during the summer training camp, a 
notice posted in the cafeteria caught my 
eye.
choice_data_list: A hidden talent show by volunteer staff?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks like fun, doesn't it? I 
heard there are even modest prizes.
choice_data_list: 有志職員の、かくし芸大会？
choice_data_list_en: A talent show by volunteer staff?

text_block_list.text:
The winner's prize was a summer-themed 
blue and white bracelet. This is—
choice_data_list:
This looks like it'd go perfectly with 
Cheval's 'charm shell.'

text_block_list.text:
If I give her this bracelet, she's sure to 
be thrilled. I absolutely must win...!
choice_data_list: シュヴァルの『おまじないの貝』に合いそう
choice_data_list_en: Looks like it'd go well with Cheval's "good luck shell."

text_block_list.text:
However, performing a hidden talent in 
front of a crowd is a high hurdle. If it 
fails, it'd be too painful to watch.
choice_data_list:
Can we really do this...? I need to think 
it through carefully.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: 本当にやれるか……ちゃんと検討しないと
choice_data_list_en: Whether we can really pull it off... we'll have to consider it carefully.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>! I decided to enter the 
talent show too. With a baguette karate 
chop...!
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto, when I said I wanted to 
see your "special talent," it was kind of 
a joke... caught up in the mood of the 
moment! So please don't force yourself—
choice_data_list: えっ！？
choice_data_list_en: Wait!?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No. Living up to your student's 
expectations is what being a Trainer is 
all about. ――Watch closely. Behold my 
masterfully crafted dance.

They are formidable rivals—will I be able 
to deliver a performance superior to 
theirs?
choice_data_list:
Let's think about it just a little 
longer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: まだ……ちょっとだけ考えよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's think about it... just a little more.

text_block_list.text:
Days of staring down the application form 
continued— until finally, the deadline for 
entry arrived.
choice_data_list: I-I really have to apply today... but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um...! Trainer...!
choice_data_list: きょ、今日こそ申し込まないと……けど
choice_data_list_en: T-Today's the day I have to sign up... but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Those application forms you're 
holding—they're for the talent show, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You were hesitating... on whether to enter 
or not, weren't you?

My heart beats like a frantic bell. I 
still don't have— the courage to hold my 
head high and say yes.
choice_data_list: ...U-Um, well—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: L-Let's enter...! Trainer, please!!
choice_data_list: ……え、ええと――
choice_data_list_en: ...Uh, um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Um... I-I was watching...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san has been troubled all this 
time...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to take a step forward... but I 
just couldn't—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Just like me a year ago, when I 
couldn't work up the courage to give the 
seashell charm.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't been able to give it to you 
back then... I'm sure I'd still be 
regretting it today...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want you to have any regrets 
either, Trainer... A-And besides—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me... wants to be of 
help to you, Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't stand on stage with you, but... 
I'll do whatever I can to support you...!
choice_data_list: シュヴァル……
choice_data_list_en: Cheval...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I might not be very dependable, but... 
even if you can't move forward alone, the 
t-two of us can...!
choice_data_list:
Still... I think I'll probably just be a 
burden, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: It's really no trouble at all.
choice_data_list: でも……多分、迷惑かけると思うよ？
choice_data_list_en: Still... I think I'd probably just be a nuisance, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"You're always the one helping me, so... 
I'm glad I can be of use to you."
choice_data_list:
...Thank you, I'll take you up on that 
then.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!
choice_data_list: ……ありがとう、じゃあお願いしようかな
choice_data_list_en: ...Thanks. In that case, I'll take you up on it.

text_block_list.name: Talent Show Spectator
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! Hitting nine targets in 
a row! An undisputed victory!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I might not be very dependable, but... 
even if you can't move forward alone, the 
t-two of us can...!
choice_data_list: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if you don't have the courage right 
this second... I... I'll wait.
choice_data_list: ……ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Just like how you waited for me, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"And... when you truly feel like moving 
forward... please, take me with you."
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.text:
After spending some time confronting my 
true feelings—I decided to enter the 
talent show.
choice_data_list_en: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Talent Show Spectator
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! Hitting nine targets in 
a row! An undisputed victory!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I might not be very dependable, but... 
even if you can't move forward alone, the 
t-two of us can...!
choice_data_list:
But wouldn't that be putting too much of a 
burden on Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm completely fine...! I can't take 
center stage, but if it's support...!
choice_data_list: けど、シュヴァルに負担をかけちゃうんじゃ
choice_data_list_en: Still, wouldn't that place a burden on Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Umm... well... Wh-Why don't we look at it 
the other way around?
choice_data_list: それでも、大事な夏合宿中だし……
choice_data_list_en: Even so, we're in the middle of summer camp...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If you were in my shoes, Trainer... would 
you feel... it's a burden?
choice_data_list: ...No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-I feel the same way... So... let's move 
forward together...!"
choice_data_list: ……いや、全然
choice_data_list_en: ...No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Talent Show Spectator
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing! Hitting nine targets in 
a row! An undisputed victory!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That was some nice pitching, Trainer. 
And... congratulations on the 
championship.
choice_data_list: Thanks. So, um... here, this is for you.
Thank you. So... here, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh? H-Here, go ahead... Wait, isn't that 
the championship prize...!?
choice_data_list: ありがとう。それでさ……はい、これどうぞ
ありがとう。それで……はい、これどうぞ
choice_data_list_en: Thanks. So anyway... here, this is for you.
Thanks. And... here, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...N-No way... That can't be...
choice_data_list: 君に贈りたくて、優勝目指してたからさ
貴方に贈りたくて、優勝目指してたから
choice_data_list_en: I was aiming to win so I could give it to you.
I was aiming for victory because I wanted to present it to you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!
choice_data_list: 手伝ってもらっちゃって、情けないけど
choice_data_list_en: It's kind of pathetic that I needed help, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You're not pathetic at all...! You worked 
up your courage, kept moving forward, and 
seized victory fair and square, didn't 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer... you're so, so cool...!
choice_data_list: ...It's all because you gave me that push.

...It's all thanks to the push you gave 
me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You're always supporting me, so 
this isn't nearly enough to pay you back, 
but...
choice_data_list: ……君が背中を押してくれたおかげだよ
……貴方が背中を押してくれたおかげだよ
choice_data_list_en: ...It's thanks to you giving me that push.
...It's all thanks to the push you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just little by little... I 
hope I can... become a source of support 
for you, Trainer.
